name: clawness
description: Puts the right rules in context on every prompt, automatically — built for full-stack developers moving across frontend, backend, and SQL in one session, researchers working in bare or LaTeX-only directories, and teams who want adversarial review (security red/blue team, code critic) before merge. 212 rules across 29 domains, retrieved by relevance rather than dumped into CLAUDE.md, plus a plan-approval gate, session security hardening, and per-codebase lessons memory. Requires Python 3.10+ on PATH.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ensure_deps.py"; done; exit 0

for p in python3 python py; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git_check.py"; done; echo "[Clawness] Python 3.10+ was not found on PATH, so none of Clawness's hooks can run: no rules are being injected, and the plan gate and access guard are inactive. Tell the user in one line, and point them at the Installing Python section of https://github.com/fullymiddleaged/clawness - do not install Python for them."; exit 0
